matter_background.original: Mr. Samson Perera wishes to gift his business premises bearing Assessment No.78, Maradana Road, Borella unto his daughter Sarathi Perera. He bought this property for a sum of Rupees One Hundred Thousand (Rs.100,000/=) in 1977. And he had spent about Rupees One Million for the renovations. The market value of the property now is Rupees One Hundred Million (Rs.100,000,000/=).
